title: Captured Halting Configuration Frame
statement: Let $B$ and $F$ be finite Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet, with $k_B$ and $k_F$ work tapes, respectively. For any Boolean input $x$ and configuration $c$ of $F$ on $x$ whose state is absent, the configuration obtained by embedding $c$ into the loop construction for $B$ and $F$ equals the loop frame based on that embedded configuration, with the designated return state, input-head position inherited from $c$, blank flag and counter tapes with heads at cell $0$, a payload tape containing $c$'s output with its head at the output length, and an empty output word.
hypotheses_covered: The state of $c$ is absent (the machine has halted)
